description: Record shipped fixes, keep them live and report on them. Pick with mode: log = Record a shipped fix; checked every 6 hours, restore code on regression. Needs fixes[{url, field, new, old, via, ref}]. report = Every fix with status and results: a monthly client report. Needs fix_log_id.

brand.description: For the report: your agency name for the header.

field.description: What was changed. hreflang: new is the language code; jsonld: new is the schema type, e.g. FAQPage; redirect: new is the target URL.

new.description: Value after the fix, used to check it stays live.

note.description: Optional short note, e.g. the issue code it fixed.

old.description: Value before the fix, used for rollback. Empty if there was none.

ref.description: Optional link, e.g. the pull request.

url.description: Page the fix was made on (for a redirect: the old URL).

format.description: status (default), a client report, or GA4 annotations (one per ship date) for the Admin API.

shipped_at.description: Date the fixes went live, YYYY-MM-DD.

verify.description: Check the live pages now (4 pages per call).

webhook.description: Optional https URL (Slack, Discord, Zapier, n8n, a GitHub Action) that gets the restore code when a fix is undone.

name: fix_log
title: Fix log
